summary: Add a supported CLI transition to reopen blocked tasks
description: Claude Code observed that pinned go-workflow-stack v0.3.33 has no supported unblock/reopen command for blocked tasks. SDP-OM-026 used a direct schema-valid file move, validated with ./go validate ., as a one-off workaround. Replace that operational gap with an explicit repo-local CLI lifecycle transition; do not treat direct file moves as the supported procedure.
acceptance: A documented task reopen CLI command transitions exactly one blocked task to open through the repository lifecycle API; it rejects missing, active, already-open and done task IDs.

The transition retains the task content and prior blocked metadata, records who reopened it and why in an append-only lifecycle event, and writes atomically so a failed transition cannot leave duplicate or missing task records.

The command validates the repo-local contract, task identity and path boundaries before mutation; direct movement of files between task state directories is not documented as the normal operational path.
Behavioral tests prove successful reopen, all invalid source-state cases, event/audit content, atomic failure recovery and complete repository validation after the operation.
